questions.question: How often must a bank carry out KYC periodic updation for high-risk, medium-risk and low-risk customers under the Commercial Banks KYC Directions, 2025?

answer.text:
Under the Commercial Banks KYC Directions, 2025, the bank must carry out periodic updation of KYC:
- "at least once in every two years for high-risk customers" [Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025, p.40-41, clause n/a]
- "once in every eight years for medium risk customers" [Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025, p.40-41, clause n/a]
- "once in every 10 years for low-risk customers" [Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025, p.40-41, clause n/a] 

This is to be done "from the date of opening of the account / last KYC updation." [Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025, p.40-41, clause n/a]
citations: [Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks - Know Your Customer) Directions, 2025, p.40-41, clause n/a]

judge.notes: The candidate answer accurately provides the correct frequencies for periodic KYC updation for all risk categories as specified in the reference answer and context.

questions.question: How must banks classify their entire investment portfolio under the 2023 Investment Portfolio Directions?

answer.text: Under the 2023 Investment Portfolio Directions, banks must classify their entire investment portfolio (except investments in their own subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates) "under three categories, viz., Held to Maturity (HTM), Available for Sale (AFS) and Fair Value through Profit and Loss (FVTPL)" [Master Direction - Classification, Valuation and Operation of Investment Portfolio of Commercial Banks, p.14-15, clause n/a]. Additionally, "Held for Trading (HFT) shall be a separate investment sub-category within FVTPL" [Master Direction - Classification, Valuation and Operation of Investment Portfolio of Commercial Banks, p.14-15, clause n/a].
citations: [Master Direction - Classification, Valuation and Operation of Investment Portfolio of Commercial Banks, p.14-15, clause n/a]

questions.question: How is a guarantor's liability treated under the Wilful Defaulters Directions, 2024?

answer.text:
Based on the provided document, a guarantor's liability is treated as follows:

* "As per Section 128 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, the liability of the guarantor is coextensive with that of the principal debtor unless it is otherwise provided by the contract." [Master Direction on Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters, p.16, 8 (1)]
* "When a default happens in making payment/ repayment by the principal debtor, the lender will be able to proceed against the guarantor even without exhausting the remedies against the principal debtor." [Master Direction on Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters, p.16, 8 (2)]
* "Where a lender has made a claim on the guarantor on account of the default made by the principal debtor, the liability of the guarantor is immediate." [Master Direction on Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters, p.16, 8 (3)]
* "In case the said guarantor refuses to comply with the demand made by the lender, such guarantor shall also be considered for classification as a wilful defaulter by following the mechanism as set out in para 4 of these Directions." [Master Direction on Treatment of Wilful Defaulters and Large Defaulters, p.16, 8 (4)]

questions.question: When may a complainant go to the Ombudsman under the 2021 Scheme, and what is the maximum consequential-loss compensation?

answer.text:
Under the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021, a complaint shall not lie unless:
(a) "the complainant had, before making a complaint under the Scheme, made a written complaint to the Regulated Entity concerned" [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.6-7, clause n/a] and either the complaint was rejected wholly or partly or no reply was received within 30 days [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a]. Additionally, the complaint must be made to the Ombudsman "within one year after the complainant has received the reply from the Regulated Entity to the complaint or, where no reply is received, within one year and 30 days from the date of the complaint." [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a].
(b) The complaint is not in respect of the same cause of action already pending, settled, or dealt with on merits by an Ombudsman, Court, Tribunal, Arbitrator, or any other Forum or Authority [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a].
(c) The complaint is "not abusive or frivolous or vexatious in nature" [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a].
(d) The complaint to the Regulated Entity was made "before the expiry of the period of limitation prescribed under the Limitation Act, 1963" [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a].
(e) Complete information as specified in clause 11 is provided [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.7, clause n/a].
(f) The complaint is lodged personally or through an authorised representative "other than an advocate unless the advocate is the aggrieved person" [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.8, clause n/a].

The maximum compensation for any consequential loss suffered by the complainant that the Ombudsman has the power to provide is "Rupees 20 lakh" (or "the consequential loss suffered by the complainant or Rupees 20 lakh whichever is lower") [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.4-5, clause n/a; Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.10-11, clause n/a].
citations: [Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (consolidated text as amended August 5, 2022), p.6-7, clause n/a]
